source: lab (captured, Orbbec Femto Mega RGB; background replaced by green via Segment Anything 2 - watermark bottom right)

camera.motion: static (median-background difference shows only the ball in every frame; table and objects do not shift)
camera.perspective_cues: table top seen obliquely from slightly above; front table edge runs from (208,540) left corner to (1139,590) right corner, back edge higher (~y 450-470) behind the objects; table converges toward the back. Ball moves right->left and toward the camera: its apparent diameter grows from ~23 px to ~39 px.

ball.desc: small white ball (table-tennis-ball like), the only moving object; looks capsule-shaped in flight frames due to motion blur
ball.reference_point: centroid of the white mask (visible centre)

apparent_diameter_px.note: diam_est_px = mask width across the blur direction; +-2 px; apparent size ~ 1/depth so the ball approaches the camera by a factor ~1.7 over the clip

white_cup.desc: tall white tumbler/cup, rightmost object on table; ball starts on its right rim

glass_jar.desc: clear glass jar with metal lid, leftmost object on table

tape_roll.desc: wide translucent yellowish tape roll lying flat, between jar and cards
tape_roll.note: bottom edge set by eye (y~474), segmentation merged it with the table

card_pyramid.desc: two playing cards leaned into an A-frame (tent), left of the cup

flat_cards.desc: playing cards lying flat in front of the card pyramid

dark_card_on_table.desc: dark blue card/wallet with yellow sticker, lying flat near the front edge

table.desc: wooden table top on a single black pedestal leg
table.front_edge: left corner (208,540)-(212,570), right corner (1139,590)-(1137,620); edge thickness ~30 px
table.leg: black column x ~ 628-690 below y ~ 600 to bottom of frame

events.name: ball at rest on right rim of white cup
ball sinks slightly behind cup rim (pre-launch)
launch / release (start of flight)
events.note: between frames 11 and 12; ball jumps 17 px left, 19 px up

events.name: bounce 1 on table behind card pyramid (occluded)
bounce 2 on table at tape roll (ball in front of tape)
bounce 3 on table in front of glass jar
bounce 4 on table (shadow visible), left of jar
clip ends, ball in flight moving left
